meta.description: AYV WRLD creates focused software tools that help businesses capture leads, book customers, close quotes, collect payments, and bring customers back.

home.headline: Turn everyday work into <muted>revenue.</muted>
home.productsTitle: Six focused tools. <muted>One for every job.</muted>
home.productsBody: Each product does one thing well. Avyro is first — the rest connect to this same workspace as they launch.

features.title: Everything you need. <muted>Nothing you don''t.</muted>
features.loginBody: Access every AYV product from a single account and a shared workspace. No juggling logins or stitching tools together.
features.liveBody: Create an account, tell us about your business, and start. Each tool is built to be running the same day you sign up.
features.automationsBody: Set the rules once. Follow-ups, reminders, and requests go out on their own so nothing slips through the cracks.
features.teamsBody: No enterprise overhead. Everything is designed for owners and lean teams who need results, not a manual.
features.secureBody: Your customer data stays protected with modern authentication and per-account isolation from day one.
features.pricingBody: Each tool has one clear monthly price — or take the full bundle and pay 50% less than buying them separately.

how.title: Three steps. <muted>Infinite possibilities.</muted>
how.step1Body: Sign up in seconds with your email. One AYV WRLD account unlocks every tool as it launches.
how.step2Body: Tell us who you serve and how you work. We tailor each tool to your industry and workflow.
how.step3Body: Turn on the automations that fit you. Leads, bookings, quotes, and payments handle themselves.

bundle.title: All six tools, one price.
bundle.body: Get every AYV WRLD product in a single subscription and pay half of what they cost on their own.
bundle.productBody: Get {name} and all five other tools in one subscription for half the price of buying them separately.

cta.title: Start turning work into revenue.
cta.body: Create your AYV WRLD account today and be ready the moment each tool goes live.

footer.blurb: Focused software tools that turn everyday business tasks into automated revenue.

productPage.builtForOneJob: Built to do one job exceptionally well.
productPage.planBody: One clear monthly price. No setup fees, cancel anytime.

avyro.longDescription: Avyro helps businesses follow up with new leads quickly so more conversations turn into customers.
avyro.highlight1: Reply to every new lead in seconds, automatically
avyro.highlight2: Schedule smart follow-ups so nobody slips away
avyro.highlight3: See which leads are hot and where they came from
avyro.dashboardDescription: Follow up with new leads quickly so more conversations become customers.

velto.longDescription: Velto helps businesses take bookings and send reminders so fewer appointments are missed.
velto.highlight1: Let customers book you around the clock
velto.highlight2: Send automatic reminders before every appointment
velto.dashboardDescription: Take bookings and send reminders so fewer appointments are missed.

rovyn.longDescription: Rovyn follows up on sent quotes so businesses close more work without chasing every lead by hand.
rovyn.highlight1: Follow up on every quote automatically
rovyn.highlight2: Nudge undecided prospects at the right moment
rovyn.highlight3: Close more work without chasing by hand
rovyn.dashboardDescription: Follow up on sent quotes so more proposals turn into booked work.

orvyn.longDescription: Orvyn reminds customers about unpaid invoices so money comes in faster and fewer bills are forgotten.
orvyn.highlight1: Send automatic reminders on unpaid invoices
orvyn.highlight2: Get paid faster with less awkward chasing
orvyn.highlight3: Keep track of what's outstanding at a glance
orvyn.dashboardDescription: Payment and invoice follow-up is coming soon.

nexro.longDescription: Nexro helps businesses bring past customers back and turn happy clients into referrals.
nexro.highlight1: Win back past customers with timed campaigns
nexro.highlight2: Turn happy clients into a steady referral stream
nexro.dashboardDescription: Customer reactivation and referrals are coming soon.

ravelo.longDescription: Ravelo asks happy customers for reviews at the right time so businesses build trust without awkward follow-up.
ravelo.highlight1: Ask for reviews at the perfect moment
ravelo.highlight3: Grow your reputation without the awkward ask

command.title: Your business, connected.
command.subtitle: A real-time view of the client journey across {organization}, from first lead to won work.
command.emptyTitle: Start with your first client record.
command.emptyBody: Add a lead in Avyro, a booking in Velto, or a quote in Rovyn. This dashboard will connect the real activity as your workflow grows.
command.funnelHelp: The funnel follows record links. Raw totals include every record, whether connected or not.
command.rawTotal: {count, plural, one {# raw record} other {# raw records}}
command.leadToBookingFormula: {numerator} leads with a linked booking ÷ {denominator} total leads
command.bookingToQuoteFormula: {numerator} bookings with a linked quote ÷ {denominator} total bookings
command.pipelineFormula: Sum of amounts on {valued} sent or followed-up quotes. {missing} open quotes have no amount.
command.daysOverdue: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
command.inDays: In {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
command.attentionEmpty: Nothing is overdue or due in the next seven days.
command.directoryHelp: Search and review each client's contact details, health, next action, and connected records in one place.
command.healthRules: Deterministic rules only: lost leads, no-shows, lost quotes without a win, or 7+ overdue days are at risk. Other overdue or unconnected leads need attention. Won or actively progressing journeys are on track.
command.clientsEmpty: Add an Avyro lead to track connected client progress.
command.clientsEmptyHelp: Client records will appear here with their connected bookings and quotes.

command.resultsCount: {count, plural, one {# client shown} other {# clients shown}}
